title: Volfart-2020-neurophysiological-10.1371/journal.pbio.3000659
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from the left ventral temporal cortex of three epilepsy patients (with data) viewing streams of faces and written names of famous identities in a crossmodal fast periodic visual stimulation (frequency-tagging) paradigm. Identities were presented at 4 Hz with an identity change every 7th item (0.571 Hz), alongside face-only and name-only control conditions. This derivative dataset repackages the authors' low-pass filtered, sequence-cut Letswave files into BIDS iEEG format, with electrode coordinates in Talairach space.
methods_description: SEEG recorded with Micromed systems at University Hospital of Nancy during frequency-tagging stimulation (faces and/or names at 4 Hz, identity change every 7th item). Authors' preprocessing in Letswave 5 included 30 Hz low-pass Butterworth filtering (order 4) and cutting sequences from 2 s after onset to about 61 s. Sequences per condition were merged and repackaged into BrainVision format.
